title: Simplify the editor empty state to a plain hint, dropping the icon/card treatment
description: Address item 4 of `novas-tasks.md` (`referencia-5.png`): replace `EditorEmptyState.tsx`'s current card-style empty state (`FilePlus2` icon, 'Página em branco' title, description, and an 'Adicionar conteúdo' button that opens the `BLOCK_GROUPS` dropdown) with a single, unobtrusive line of muted placeholder text telling the user to start typing and that markdown works — matching the plain 'Type something or type / for commands' style shown in `referencia-5.png`. No icon, no card/border, no button.
acceptanceCriteria: `EditorEmptyState.tsx` no longer renders the `EmptyState` icon/card/button treatment
An empty page shows a single muted line of placeholder-style text prompting the user to start typing and mentioning markdown support (and, once TASK-104 lands, that '/' opens the block menu)
The placeholder disappears as soon as the user starts typing, same as before
No dead imports remain (`EmptyState` wrapper usage, `FilePlus2` icon) if fully unused after this change

steps.details: In `EditorEmptyState.tsx`, remove the icon/card/button and render simple muted placeholder text instead, styled consistently with the rest of the editor typography.
Remove now-unused imports (`EmptyState` wrapper, `FilePlus2`, `BLOCK_GROUPS` dropdown trigger) if nothing else in the file references them.
Open a blank page, confirm the simplified placeholder renders and disappears on typing, and that visual style matches `referencia-5.png`.

technicalNotes: Depends on TASK-103 so the placeholder copy and surrounding chrome are consistent with the borderless, toolbar-free content area landed there.

`EditorEmptyState.tsx` no longer needs an `editor` prop at all — with the button/dropdown/embed-picker gone, nothing in the component touches the editor instance anymore (first-block insertion is fully covered by `BlockHandles`' hover '+' and the TASK-103 '/' menu, both of which already work on an empty first paragraph). Call site in `ContentEditor.tsx` updated to `<EditorEmptyState />` (no props) and the `editor &&` guard dropped from that render line since the component has nothing left to null-check.

New `.sb-editor-empty-hint` CSS class in `editor.css` deliberately duplicates `.sb-editor .ProseMirror`'s exact padding (incl. the TASK-92 mobile breakpoint) rather than reusing a shared Tailwind utility, so the hint line lands precisely over the empty first line instead of floating detached — single source of truth for that one magic-number set.

Copy is in Portuguese (matching the rest of the still-untranslated product pre-TASK-110), not the literal English 'Type something or type / for commands' from `referencia-5.png` — that string was cited in the task description as the *style* reference (plain, single-line, mentions '/'), not a mandate to pre-translate this one string ahead of the dedicated translation task.

Verified via Playwright/Chromium against the real dev app: old 'Página em branco' card and 'Adicionar conteúdo' button are gone (0 matches), the new single muted line renders with the expected copy, `BlockHandles`' hover '+' still appears correctly positioned next to it, and the hint disappears the instant a character is typed. Zero console/page errors. `@/components/EmptyState` (the shared wrapper) is still used elsewhere (`AdminSearch.tsx`, `DashboardPage.tsx`) so it was left untouched, only its usage here was removed.
